Name: hybrid_typology_embedding
Title: Hybrid Typology-Embedding Clustering for Low-Resource Asian NER
Experiment: Replace the pure embedding agglomerative clustering in cluster_embedding() with a hybrid method: first compute XLM-R language-ID [CLS] embeddings, then apply soft typology constraints (HEAD_FINAL vs HEAD_INITIAL) as a penalty term in the distance matrix before clustering. Use elbow method or silhouette score to select k instead of fixing k=2. Compare Mongolian entity-level F1 against the baseline linguistic and embedding conditions.

Name: dynamic_k_selection
Title: Automatic Cluster Count Selection for Multilingual NER Transfer
Experiment: Modify cluster_embedding() to automatically select the number of clusters using the elbow method or silhouette score on language embeddings, instead of fixing n_clusters=2. Also try K-means as an alternative to Agglomerative clustering. Evaluate whether data-driven k selection improves Mongolian (mn) F1 over the fixed-k baseline while keeping the four evaluation conditions unchanged.
